Bright sunny outdoor tennis court with green hard court, white lines, net, spectator stands filled with audience in chairs watching the match, natural daylight, premium cinematic sports-ad style. Strict Character Consistency: Same beautiful Western woman throughout — exact face, fair skin tone, long wavy blonde hair in a sporty ponytail with soft strands flowing, fresh natural makeup with glowing skin and glossy lips. She wears a cute babypink tennis-style polo dress with small white embroidered McDonald's golden arches logo on the chest, matching babypink visor/cap, white sports socks, and white sneakers. Perfect fabric physics and athletic movement. Camera: Slow premium cinematic movements — elegant tracking, smooth orbits, gentle push-ins, rack focus. Scenes: Wide establishing shot: She is playing tennis against a young boy opponent on the other side of the net. Audience seated in stands watching supportively. Macro close-up on her focused eyes (natural blink, intense concentration). Slow pull-back showing her athletic form swinging the tennis racket. Dynamic rally: She moves confidently, hits the ball with power and grace. Camera orbits elegantly around her. Crowd cheering. In the middle of her forehand shot, another person (not the opponent) walks along the side of the court holding a McDonald's paper bag and eating golden fries. She suddenly notices, gets distracted, misses the shot, and has a surprised hungry smile. Ultra-photorealistic, flawless continuity, realistic hair/fabric/sweat details, natural tennis motion, soft depth of field. Ambient sounds: tennis ball hits, crowd cheers, breeze, and upbeat music.
